adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the permission flag is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))` and stored in a variable named `isTeamAdminOrOwner`. This requires the user to be BOTH a team admin and a team owner to pass the team-based permission check. The subsequent gate `if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee) throw FORBIDDEN` will therefore deny access to team admins who are not also owners (assuming `isTeamAdmin` and `isTeamOwner` are distinct), matching the reported 403 behavior.
